part.text:
Fixed. In `replacer.go`, `{file.*}` replacements now strip a single trailing end-of-line marker (`\r\n` on Windows, `\n` otherwise) from the file contents, so a secret file saved with a normal trailing newline (per Unix convention) works with placeholders like `acme_dns cloudflare {file./path/secret}`. Files with multiple trailing newlines keep all but the last one, matching the tests in `replacer_test.go`.

Verification: `go test .` in the container passes (all replacer tests, including the trailing-newline cases).
